description: This file implements the runmode addon for CodeMirror, providing functions for syntax highlighting and tokenization, including StringStream class, mode resolution, and execution logic.

classes.name: StringStream
classes.description: A class that provides string tokenization and parsing utilities for syntax highlighting.

methods.name: copyObj
methods.description: Copies properties from one object to another, with optional overwrite control.

methods.name: countColumn
methods.description: Counts the column offset in a string, considering tab characters.

methods.name: nothing
methods.description: Empty function used as a placeholder.

methods.name: createObj
methods.description: Creates a new object with a specified prototype and optional properties.

methods.name: defineMode
methods.description: Defines a new syntax mode for CodeMirror.

methods.name: defineMIME
methods.description: Associates a MIME type with a mode specification.

methods.name: resolveMode
methods.description: Resolves a mode specification into a mode configuration object.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Initializes and returns a mode object based on a specification.

methods.name: extendMode
methods.description: Attaches additional properties to an existing mode.

methods.name: copyState
methods.description: Creates a copy of a mode's state.

methods.name: innerMode
methods.description: Finds the innermost mode and state at a given position.

methods.name: startState
methods.description: Returns the starting state for a mode.

methods.name: runMode
methods.description: Performs syntax highlighting on a string using a specified mode, calling a callback with tokenized segments.
